pages.title: SongNodes

pages.title: Set Builder
pages.description: Harmonic wave-shaped DJ set sequencer with Camelot transition analysis, energy curve tracking, and multi-platform export.
pages.rationale: Production operational tool; dual persistence (LocalStorage outbox + PostgreSQL library.saved_sets); handles full setlist lifecycle.

pages.title: Pathfinder
pages.description: Graph-based transition pathfinder calculating harmonic, energy-aligned stepping stones between distant tracks.
pages.rationale: Restored in package R2 (#177) and wired in P1 (#180); connects directly to Memgraph pathfinding Cypher queries via REST API.

pages.title: Camelot Matrix
pages.description: Interactive Camelot wheel and harmonic modulation matrix displaying musical compatibility and energy shift potential.
pages.rationale: Consolidated into single production route in package P2 (#182); implements official SN.camelot and SN.compat mathematical models.

pages.title: Scrape Targets
pages.description: Priority queue and management console for artist and track search targets dispatched to unified scrapers.
pages.rationale: Production target dispatch tool; backed by PostgreSQL migration 280; prevents duplicate target insertion and coordinates scraper runs.

pages.title: Tracklist Import
pages.description: AI-assisted tracklist ingestion, OCR text parsing, and sequential playlist bronze layer loader.
pages.rationale: Feature route wired in P3 (#185); enforces completeness guard (positions 1..N with no gaps) and loads into bronze_scraped_playlists.

pages.title: Pipeline Telemetry
pages.description: Real-time scraper telemetry, Celery queue drain rates, Medallion stage progression, and job dead-letter revival.
pages.rationale: Core operational health console; monitors async Celery execution and ensures data layer consistency across Medallion tiers.

pages.title: System Settings
pages.description: Credential store, OAuth streaming token manager (TIDAL & Spotify), API provider configuration, and display preferences.
pages.rationale: Production administrative and preferences engine; securely manages API credentials without committing raw secrets (SEC6).

pages.title: Page Not Found
pages.description: Honest empty/error boundary state displayed when a requested URL is unregistered.
pages.rationale: Canonical error boundary adhering to Design System rule 08 (Honest states, never mock data); registered in registry.tsx:22.

stores.name: PostgreSQL Bronze Ingestion Store
stores.role: Raw, immutable capture of external scraped playlists and track items.
stores.lock_or_concurrency: Transaction-scoped MVCC; unique constraints on (source, source_playlist_id)
stores.source_of_truth: Yes, for un-normalized raw source payloads.

stores.name: PostgreSQL Silver Normalized Store
stores.role: Deduplicated, enriched tracks, verified sequential transitions (1..N), and provider consensus evidence.
stores.lock_or_concurrency: Row-level locks during Celery enrichment worker drain; idempotent by job_id
stores.source_of_truth: Yes, authoritative single source of truth for all verified track pairings and metadata consensus.

stores.name: PostgreSQL Gold Projection Store
stores.role: Denormalized, read-optimized projection of tracks and transitions for fast API queries.
stores.lock_or_concurrency: Maintained by projection_consume Celery worker; rebuildable from silver.

stores.name: Memgraph Graph Database
stores.role: In-memory graph topology enabling sub-50ms Cypher queries for harmonic pathfinding and transition traversals.
stores.schema_or_format: Nodes: (:Track {id, title, artist, bpm, camelot, energy}); Edges: [:TRANSITIONS_TO {occurrences, weight}]
stores.source_of_truth: No, projected from PostgreSQL silver transitions.

stores.name: Redis Broker, Lease & Telemetry Store
stores.role: Celery job queue broker, worker lease management, rate-limiting counters, and real-time scraper window telemetry.
stores.schema_or_format: Redis keys: celery, job_leases:*, scraper_window:*, rate_limit:*
stores.lock_or_concurrency: Redis single-threaded atomic operations; TTL-backed leases

stores.name: musicLibrary Curated SQLite Database
stores.role: Local offline curated DJ database holding crates, appearances, rotation history, and setlists.
stores.schema_or_format: SQLite: tracks, track_tags, appearances, chart_positions, rotation_history, sets, set_tracks
stores.lock_or_concurrency: File-based SQLite locks; single-writer batch rebuild via pipeline/run_weekly.py db
stores.source_of_truth: Yes, authoritative for DJ crate assignments and High/Standard/Archive rotation lifecycle.

stores.name: Filesystem Ledger & Export Volumes
stores.role: Immutable weekly ledger snapshots, crate CSVs, Rekordbox XML exports, and static sync files.
stores.schema_or_format: TSV / CSV / XML (Rekordbox MusicLibrary XML schema) / JSON
stores.source_of_truth: Yes, ledger is the permanent audit trail for weekly rotation calculations.

stores.name: Client Browser LocalStorage & SessionStorage
stores.role: Offline set outbox, active UI theme preference ('dark'|'light'|'booth'), and transient OAuth state.
stores.lock_or_concurrency: Single-thread per tab; storage events across same-origin tabs
stores.source_of_truth: Yes, for un-synced offline draft setlists.

gaps.title: Disconnected Rekordbox Booth Performance Feedback Loop
gaps.current_state: Sets are exported to Rekordbox XML (outputs/rekordbox_musicLibrary.xml), but actual live DJ booth history (played order, timestamps, crowd reactions) remains trapped on USB drives / HISTORY.m3u8 and never returns to SongNodes.
gaps.consequence: Live transitions performed at gigs do not increment occurrence_count in silver_track_transitions; rotation aging algorithms cannot observe real play history.
gaps.proposed_fix: Implement Pioneer USB Booth History Ingester (services/library/booth_history.py + /sets/history view) that parses Pioneer HISTORY.m3u8 files, updates track play history, and commits verified live transitions into silver_track_transitions.
gaps.contract: BoothHistoryIngestContract {m3u8_content, venue_name, set_date, transitions: [{from_id, to_id, played_at}]}

gaps.title: Dual Storage Disconnect (PostgreSQL library.* vs SQLite dj_library.sqlite)
gaps.current_state: The weekly pipeline writes to SQLite (dj_library.sqlite), while the SongNodes web application writes to PostgreSQL schema library.*. The sync script only copies a static JSON file (data/music-library.json).
gaps.consequence: Curator tag edits or crate adjustments made in the web UI do not propagate back to the weekly SQLite ledger, leading to split-brain library state.
gaps.proposed_fix: Deploy Bi-Directional Library Synchronization Bridge (services/library/bridge.py) with checksum reconciliation and single-writer lease enforcement.
gaps.contract: LibrarySyncContract {version, checksum_sha256, last_reconciled_at, changes: [{table, action, key, data}]}

gaps.title: Missing Audio Fingerprint & AcoustID Transition Segmenter
gaps.current_state: Pairing transitions rely exclusively on scraped textual tracklists (1001Tracklists, MixesDB). Recorded DJ audio mixes cannot be automatically segmented or verified against audio fingerprints.
gaps.consequence: Un-tracklisted DJ sets and radio broadcasts cannot be mined for transitions; track version mismatches (e.g. Dub Mix vs Vocal Mix) cannot be validated by audio waveform.
gaps.proposed_fix: Deploy Essentia / Chromaprint Audio Segmenter worker (services/audio-analysis/segmenter.py) that ingests recorded audio mixes, detects transition crossfades, and queries AcoustID for automated setlist synthesis.
gaps.contract: AudioMixSegmentContract {audio_url, duration, segments: [{start_sec, end_sec, chromaprint, acoustid_match}]}

gaps.title: Unwired Scraper Target Queue Feedback
gaps.current_state: When a curator adds an artist target in /library or /sources/targets, it writes to target_tracks in PostgreSQL. However, the standalone musicLibrary pipeline reads static config/sources.json and does not poll this queue.
gaps.consequence: High-priority targets added by the user remain dormant until manually scraped, creating an operational bottleneck.
gaps.proposed_fix: Wire automated target dispatcher cron that syncs PostgreSQL target_tracks directly into the weekly scraper schedule.

gaps.title: Outbox Projection Lag Invisibility
gaps.current_state: Graph projection (projection_consume) polls PostgreSQL outbox every 15 seconds. During bulk scraping, projection lags behind silver ingestion with no real-time push notification to the UI.
gaps.consequence: Users browsing /library or /paths see stale transition data without an indicator that background projection is currently catching up.
gaps.proposed_fix: Add WebSocket or Server-Sent Events (SSE) notification stream on /api/v1/outbox/status that broadcasts active projection lag and displays a non-intrusive FreshnessStamp pill.

sister_tasks.title: Implement Booth History Ingestion for Pioneer Rekordbox HISTORY.m3u8
sister_tasks.impact: Closes Gap 01 by harvesting live performance setlists from USB drives, updating rotation decay, and writing verified transitions to SongNodes.
sister_tasks.verification: python3 pipeline/run_weekly.py ingest-booth --file sample_history.m3u8 parses order and outputs valid transition pairs.

sister_tasks.title: Bi-Directional PostgreSQL Library Synchronizer
sister_tasks.impact: Closes Gap 02 by enabling automated two-way synchronization between dj_library.sqlite and PostgreSQL library.* schema.
sister_tasks.verification: Run sync_songnodes.py; verify checksum equality between SQLite tracks and PostgreSQL library.tracks.

sister_tasks.title: Target Scrape Queue Ingestion Integration
sister_tasks.impact: Closes Gap 04 by pulling priority target tracks from SongNodes into the Sunday morning scrape batch.
sister_tasks.verification: Weekly run fetches target_tracks list and appends to weekly spider targets.

sister_tasks.title: Formula Guard Enforcement on All Crate CSV Exports
sister_tasks.impact: Guarantees OWASP CSV injection protection by prepending apostrophes to text cells starting with =, +, -, @ across all weekly CSV exports.
sister_tasks.verification: Inspect generated outputs/crates/*.csv; verify malicious prefixes are guarded.

sister_tasks.title: Design System Token Alignment on Standalone Set Builder Artifact
sister_tasks.impact: Eliminates legacy hardcoded CSS in artifact/index.html; replaces with exact SongNodes Design System v1.4.0 tokens.
sister_tasks.verification: Visual regression check; run token audit script to ensure 0 undeclared hex/font literals.

sister_tasks.title: Automated Audio Preview Snippet Linker
sister_tasks.impact: Resolves and stores 30s audio preview URLs directly into dj_library.sqlite to enable offline auditioning in Naarm Set Builder.
sister_tasks.verification: Query SQLite: SELECT preview_url FROM tracks WHERE preview_url IS NOT NULL returns valid CDN links.

proposed_modules.name: Booth History Ingester
proposed_modules.core_operation: Parses sequential timestamps from Pioneer booth exports, matches track titles against silver_enriched_tracks, increments rotation counters, and commits live transitions into silver_track_transitions.

proposed_modules.name: Realtime Graph Outbox Daemon
proposed_modules.core_operation: Replaces 15-second polling projection with sub-second event-driven Bolt synchronization directly updating Memgraph nodes and transition edges.

proposed_modules.name: Bi-Directional Library Bridge
proposed_modules.core_operation: Enforces single-writer locks, compares table checksums, bi-directionally syncs crate memberships and user tags, and exports fresh static JSON.

proposed_modules.name: Audio Preview Stream Caching Proxy
proposed_modules.core_operation: Downloads and caches 30-second audio preview snippets locally, generates waveform peak JSON arrays, and streams audio offline with zero external network latency.
